_how: An exception records the security owner's approval of one fixable High/Critical finding, so it doesn't pause a run for a security review again: the CVE (or Trivy secret rule) ID, the package it is in, why it is acceptable, who approved it (the security owner), and when it expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days out). An expired exception needs a review again: every run pauses until it is renewed or removed.
